# YouInc

> YouInc turns your connected accounts into a live double-entry ledger, then renders it as an executive dashboard — net worth, cashflow, runway, income, expenses, and exceptions.

YouInc is a founder-led, New Zealand-built personal finance ledger. Bank sync runs read-only through Akahu, manual accounts cover anything a bank feed can't see, and the full ledger exports as portable, hledger-compatible plain-text journals — no lock-in.

## Product

- [Home](https://youinc.net/): Run yourself like a company — the YouInc landing page.
- [Live demo](https://youinc.net/demo): The real dashboard shell and widgets running on sample data, no sign-up required.

- [Custom builds](https://youinc.net/custom-builds): Bespoke widgets, integrations, and AI agents built on your live YouInc ledger.
- [Integrations](https://youinc.net/integrations): How YouInc connects to Akahu, supported banks, manual accounts, exports, and custom integrations.
- [Use cases](https://youinc.net/use-cases): Example ways people can use YouInc for net worth, runway, cashflow, manual accounts, and custom finance views.
- [Compare](https://youinc.net/compare): How YouInc compares with budgeting apps, spreadsheets, personal finance apps, and accounting tools.
